verdict.rationale: No evidence shows a setting to block image or CSS resources during fetching. The closest workaround is `x-engine: curl`, described as a lightweight, no-JS fetch that by implication skips browser subresource loading, but this is inferred rather than documented. `x-retain-images` only controls how images appear in the output, not bandwidth. Missing for 10: an explicit resource-blocking option for images/CSS, documentation that blocking is on by default, any evidence of bandwidth or speed gains, and hands-on corroboration.
